runs.text: Transaction is a standing order. A standing order is an instruction given by a party having explicit authority on the debtor’s account to debit, i.e. either debit account owner or originating party, to an account servicer, to process credit transfers at specified intervals during an implicit or explicit period of time. It is given once, and is valid for an open or closed period of time.
